# Newbery fixtures

annual-2024.html, annual-2025.html and annual-2026.html are structural excerpts captured from the official ALA Youth Media Award announcement URLs documented in awards/data/newbery_provenance.md on 2026-10-07. They retain the original h1 and the Newbery HTML through the neighboring Caldecott heading delimiter. Navigation, advertising, unrelated awards and scripts were omitted. The fragments are source-grounded excerpts, not complete downloaded pages. Their identities are independently cross-checked against page 1 of the March 2026 ALA cumulative PDF.

Older listing/detail excerpts predate this extension. Historical synthetic test helpers remain clearly synthetic; their purpose is parser/cache control-flow verification, not evidence for the historical catalog. Production live verification retrieved all three original ALA historical listing pages.
